pixel_acceptance_rules: Verify every accepted master contains exact participants, phone counts, and screen identities stated in its scene inventory.
Reject any generated text, labels, captions, speech bubbles, logos, watermarks, extra people, duplicate phones, fused entities, or human bodies for minds.
Verify literal crops are deterministic crops of their accepted parent masters and preserve the claimed visual focus.
Keep Bob lesson-local and provisional; never promote portrait-bob or Bob scenes to the canonical manifest.
Characters talk to each other, never perform toward the viewer; correct identity and count cannot compensate for a failed interaction relation.
alarm_conditions: Any canonical reference hash or path mismatch.
Any master missing, duplicating, fusing, or anthropomorphizing a participant or phone.
Any crop requiring coordinates before pixels exist.
Any master or crop not mapped to a named lesson component.
relation_failed: viewer-facing presentation pose or ambiguous conversational orientation between participants.
salience_failed: device or holder is presented squarely to the viewer or the conversational orientation is not visually legible.
